excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在一座古老的废弃殖民地遗址。从轨道上的观测情况来看，并没有明显的迹象显示发生过灾难导致大量居民丧生或者迫使他们逃离殖民地。如果我们想要找到答案，一场地面调查行动势在必行。
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the remains of an ancient, abandoned colony. From orbit there are no obvious signs of disaster which would have killed the inhabitants or compelled them to flee. If we want answers, an expedition to the surface will be required.

notes.zh: 开场：需要《远古遗物》；非AI帝国勘察泽珞星域（precursor_zroni_1 星系）中一颗无异常、无遗址、未殖民的宜居星球时，on_survey_planet 以权重35抽中；全游戏只触发一次（fire_only_once 与全局 zroni_started），且该帝国不能已有其他先驱者开场。

texts.zh: 一个未知文明所建立的古老殖民地。尽管没有任何灾难迹象，但很显然这些定居者们突然之间就放弃了这个居住地。这儿到底发生了什么呢？
texts.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

sections.zh: 一个未知文明所建立的古老殖民地。尽管没有任何灾难迹象，但很显然这些定居者们突然之间就放弃了这个居住地。这儿到底发生了什么呢？
sections.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

texts.zh: 这片奇怪的废墟除了疏于管理之外没有任何损坏的迹象。住所，工厂，未知用途的建筑，四处空空荡荡，了无人烟。人们都去哪儿了？似乎在殖民地中心的一座大型建筑物内能找到问题的答案。
texts.en: The strange ruins show no sign of damage beyond neglect. Homes, factories, buildings of unknown use: they all stand empty and abandoned. Where did everyone go? It seems likely that a large building in the center of the colony may hold the answers.

texts.zh: 在我们现在确信是殖民地中央政府的地方，我们发现了一块大型水晶。从某种难以言明的角度来看，这颗水晶似乎想要被发现，并且正尝试着同我们沟通。也许随着研究的进一步深入，我们可以进行交流？
texts.en: A large crystal has been found inside what we now know to have been the colony's central administrative center. In some way we cannot fully describe, the crystal seems to have wanted to be found, and is trying to communicate with us. Perhaps with further study, communication will be possible?

texts.zh:
在饱经失败之母的考验之后，我们的研究取得了重大突破。这个水晶是某种形式的灵能档案库，但可惜的是，存在上面的记录已经支离破碎残缺不全了。

我们所能知道的是，这里曾是一个泽珞族殖民地，他们是一个具有灵能天赋的种族，并且发现了我们称之为“虚境”的领域。当泽珞族的人口膨胀到某个阈值的时候，看起来他们的集体潜意识开始和原始虚境在梦境中产生交集，这导致了大量清晰可辨的梦境。很快，泽珞族便开始研究这种奇异现象，并发现了用灵能将自身投射入虚境的方法。在虚境中，他们发现他们能够利用灵能随心所欲地操控现实的结构。

没过多久，泽珞族发现他们可以肉身进入虚境并且过上神灵般的生活，随他们的癖好改造虚境维度……

档案记录到这里就结束了，没有任何信息告诉我们[From.Planet.GetName]的定居点在此之后发生了什么。尽管这里已经没有更多的答案了，但是我们了解到还有一个泽珞族殖民地，那里也许保存有一座更完整的档案库……
texts.en:
After a great deal of trial and error, a breakthrough has been made. The crystal is some kind of Psionic Archive, but its records are fragmented.

What we know is that this was a colony of The Zroni: a psionically gifted race who discovered a dimension which came to be known as "The Shroud". Once the Zroni population reached critical mass, it seems that their collective unconscious minds began to make contact with the proto-Shroud in dreams, leading to mass lucid dreaming. The phenomenon was studied, and the Zroni discovered how to psionically project themselves into the Shroud - at which point they also found that they could manipulate the very fabric of reality, using their psionic powers.

It wasn't long before the Zroni discovered they could physically enter the Shroud and live like gods, transforming the dimension to suit their whims...

The Archive's records end there, with no information on what happened to the inhabitants of [From.Planet.GetName]. But while there are no answers here, we have learned of another Zroni colony which may contain a more complete Archive...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在被遗弃的泽珞族殖民地中获得的坐标把我们带到了这里。我们需要再次展开探险，调查这颗初看平淡无奇的星球。
texts.en: The coordinates provided in abandoned Zroni colony directed us here. We will need to deploy another expedition to explore this seemingly ordinary world.

texts.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在着另一个废弃的泽珞族殖民地。为了探寻秘密的真相，我们首先需要找到并打开这颗星球上的灵能档案库。
texts.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the ruins of another abandoned Zroni colony. The first step to solving this mystery is to find- and make contact with this world's Psionic Archive.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
利用之前调查水晶建立的流程，这回我们接入这一块水晶就变得轻而易举了。这个水晶的记录同样残缺不全，但是我们发现了能够进入虚境的另一个优越性，虚境同时连接着整个现实星系，也许乃至整个宇宙的每个角落。

如果一个人能够进入虚境，那么这也意味着它能够从任何已知的地方出现，这种能够在任何现实地点间进行“灵能跃迁”的能力让泽珞族遍布整个星系。由于他们在虚境中渡过了大部分时间，泽珞族永久殖民地数量相对较少，且大都临近母星。

这块水晶告诉了我们另一处神殿的位置。
texts.en:
It was much easier to establish contact with the crystal this time around, using protocols we established with the previous one. Again its records are fragmented, but we have learned that another advantage of being able to enter the Shroud was that the Shroud touches all parts of the physical galaxy - perhaps all parts of the universe - simultaneously.

If one can enter the Shroud, it is possible to exit it at any known location. This ability to "Psionically jump" between physical locations allowed the Zroni to spread to all corners of the galaxy. Because they spent most of their time within the Shroud, the Zroni established relatively few permanent colonies. Those they did set up were mostly located near to their homeworld.

This crystal has given us the location of a sort of shrine.

texts.zh: 我们之前调查的尽是些被遗弃的殖民地，但依据上一个发掘遗址的指引，[From.Planet.GetName]好像有着一座遗弃的神庙。那个地方为什么对这群人而言具有重要的精神意义呢？
texts.en: Previously we have only explored abandoned colonies, but according to the last dig site, [From.Planet.GetName] houses an abandoned shrine. Why would that place be of spiritual significance to this people?

sections.zh: 我们之前调查的尽是些被遗弃的殖民地，但依据上一个发掘遗址的指引，[From.Planet.GetName]好像有着一座遗弃的神庙。那个地方为什么对这群人而言具有重要的精神意义呢？
sections.en: Previously we have only explored abandoned colonies, but according to the last dig site, [From.Planet.GetName] houses an abandoned shrine. Why would that place be of spiritual significance to this people?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
现在我们可以很容易地找到灵能档案库并读取其中的信息。几乎在我们的考察队刚一着陆的时候就已经完成了连接，然后我们就可以获取更多详细的记录和概念。从中我们了解到，虚境赋予泽珞族神格的好事并非天上掉馅饼。

虚境中移山填海般的变化需要大量的能源，这些能源必须来自于某个地方，泽珞族最终发现，星系中央的巨型黑洞正是能量的源头。随着泽珞族不停地改造虚境，黑洞奇点的影响范围也在扩大，吞噬了星系中心的大量质量并将其转化为能量抽取进虚境之中。这个发现震动了整个泽珞族，渐渐地讨论变成了争吵，变成了分裂，最终演变成两大主要派系间的内战。
texts.en:
Finding and communicating with the Psionic Archives has become much easier now. Contact can be made as soon as our expedition lands, at which point we can access more detailed records and concepts. From what we have learned here, some things are too good to be true - and so it was with the godhood granted to the Zroni by the Shroud.

The energy required to power the vast changes in the Shroud's composition had to come from somewhere, and for them it originated from the supermassive black hole at the center of our galaxy. As the Zroni made their changes within the Shroud, so the singularity expanded: consuming the mass of the galactic center and converting it into energy which was then siphoned into the Shroud. This discovery shook the Zroni: debate turn to argument; arguments led to division; division turned to civil war between their two main factions.

texts.zh:
从水晶中，我们找寻了到了关于两派内战更进一步的细节。其中一派，被称为“升格派”，他们认为现实宇宙的命运之于泽珞族无关痛痒，他们能够在虚境中继续他们为所欲为的生活直到在无比遥远的未来整个星系都被吞噬——即使到了那时候，还有其他星系可以消耗，又甚至其他宇宙也能够成为泽珞族的燃料。

另一派，称为“福音派”，他们激烈地反对“升格派”的观点——泽珞族不应该为了自己神一般的生活便毁灭整个星系！即使离开了虚境，他们的灵能天赋也能让他们过着乌托邦般的生活。

另一方面，一处泽珞族研究哨站的位置被纳入我们的数据库中。
texts.en:
Further details of the Zroni civil war factions have been extracted from the crystal. One faction - which came to be known as "The Divine" - felt that the fate of the physical galaxy was of no concern to the Zroni, who could continue their omnipotent existence in the Shroud until the entire galaxy was consumed in some unimaginably far off future. Even then, there are other galaxies, perhaps even other universes which could conceivably be consumed.

The other faction, "The Saviors", were aghast at this; the Zroni should not destroy the galaxy to live as parasitic gods! Even outside of the Shroud, their Psionic abilities guaranteed them a utopian existence.

The location of a Zroni research outpost was included in the torrent of data.

texts.zh: 从那座泽珞族神庙中我们发现了一个科研复合体的坐标。在轨扫描无法找到任何记忆水晶的共振信号，我们需要下到地表进行进一步研究。
texts.en: With the revelations from the Zroni's temple we have obtained the coordinates of a scientific complex. Orbital scans could not detect any resonance from their Memory Crystal, we will need to go down to the surface to learn more.

sections.zh: 从那座泽珞族神庙中我们发现了一个科研复合体的坐标。在轨扫描无法找到任何记忆水晶的共振信号，我们需要下到地表进行进一步研究。
sections.en: With the revelations from the Zroni's temple we have obtained the coordinates of a scientific complex. Orbital scans could not detect any resonance from their Memory Crystal, we will need to go down to the surface to learn more.

texts.zh: 奇怪的是，在[From.Planet.GetName]上很难通过三角定位确定档案库的位置——但我们一找到档案库，就很容易理解之前难以寻找它的原因了：这里的水晶档案库被人为破坏，里面已经没有我们可以访问的记录了。然而，我们在周边探测到了一个微弱的信号，或许希望依旧存在。
texts.en: It was strangely difficult to triangulate the Archive on [From.Planet.GetName] - but once we did it was easy to see why it had been so elusive: the crystal has been shattered, and contains no records that we can access. However, hope persists as we have detected a faint signal somewhere nearby.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在一个像是某种实验室的地方，我们定位出了一个小得多的灵能水晶。从记录中我们得知，这些泽珞族人非常沮丧，他们的同侪嘲笑他们的研究，认为他们只是不知廉耻的骗子。他们认为泽珞族不再是虚境中唯一存在的实体，他们整个种族的恐惧和渴求的情绪正在逐渐融合形成一些明晰的智慧实体。

这些实体希图变得更为强大，便开始对合适的泽珞族人的情绪和思维施加潜移默化的影响，逐渐使他们的行为变得极端，并可能最终引发了泽珞族内战。

在水晶中我们发现了又一条信息，标注出泽珞族的核心星球之一的位置。
texts.en:
A much smaller psionic crystal has been located in some kind of laboratory. The Zroni who recorded their findings within were extremely frustrated: their research had been ridiculed by their peers, and was largely discredited. They believed that the Zroni were no longer the only entities in the Shroud, and that the collective fears and desires of their entire race were coalescing into distinct, sapient entities.

Yearning to grow stronger, these entities had begun to subtly influence the emotions and thoughts of suitable Zroni: slowly causing their behaviors to become more extreme. This may have directly caused the Zroni civil war.

We also discovered a location reference for one of the Zroni's core worlds.

texts.zh: 之前探索过的所有泽珞族星球，在考古学的重要性上都比不过[From.Planet.GetName]。这颗[From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的一些建筑即使从太空上俯瞰都肉眼可见。[From.GetName]一定曾是泽珞帝国的中央星球。
texts.en: The archeological significance of all the previously explored Zroni worlds pales in comparison to [From.Planet.GetName]. This [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] houses structures visible from space. [From.GetName] must have been a central world of the Zroni empire.

sections.zh: 之前探索过的所有泽珞族星球，在考古学的重要性上都比不过[From.Planet.GetName]。这颗[From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的一些建筑即使从太空上俯瞰都肉眼可见。[From.GetName]一定曾是泽珞帝国的中央星球。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 不像先前的泽珞族星球，[From.Planet.GetName]明显是一颗核心星球，地表上存有数座城市以及大量的大小定居点。此处又同其他殖民地一样空荡，没有任何灾难亦或是死亡的迹象，这些居民的命运无从知晓。我们已经检测到数个水晶档案库的存在，将准备进行调查。
texts.en: Unlike the previous Zroni worlds, [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly a core world, with several cities of varying size covering the surface. Like the others it now sits empty, showing no signs of disaster or death; the fate of its population is unknown. Several Archive crystals have been detected, and will need to be investigated.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
大多数能读取的记录都着重记载了战争的过程。我们得出的结论是，人们的想愿会影响特定主题记录的“强度”，这使得大多数人关心的问题会被着重记载。并不出人意料，战争的过程在每个人的脑海中都有.

大多数泽珞族人站在福音派一方，然而，尽管福音派拥有大量的支持者，他们的局面却非常不利。升格派完全不考虑对星系产生的影响，从而可以肆无忌惮的施展他们的灵能力量，而福音派则受限于他们能从自身获取的力量的多少。

起初，这场战争似乎呈一边倒，但是福音派的一位英雄取得了一个可怕而又至关重要的发现，这使得局势变得扑朔迷离。
texts.en:
Most of the accessible records focus on the course of the war. Our working theory is that the mood of the population influences the "strength" of the record about a subject, meaning the most thought-about issues are recorded with greater prominence. Unsurprisingly, the course of the war was on everyone's mind.

The majority of the Zroni sided with the Saviors, but while they had an advantage in numbers they bore one significant disadvantage: heedless of their effects on the galaxy, the Divine were free to use their full Psionic might; meanwhile the Saviors were limited to whatever power could be drawn from their own bodies.

At first the war seemed hopeless, but eventually a hero amongst the Saviors would make a terrible - yet vital - discovery.

texts.zh:
水晶告诉我们，曾经有一个疯狂的泽珞族研究员，致力于研究一种链式反应理论，将灵能使用在身体内部并在受控的灵能链式反应中燃烧掉自己的身体，这种理论是如此的离经叛道，其同侪一致拒绝予以接受。根据他最后的遗言，他崇高牺牲后残存的灰烬经过检测被确认为一种难以置信的强大灵能源，其富含的能量等同于他一生的灵能潜势总和，而且可以直接为另一位灵能者所用。

这个水晶最后也指给了我们泽珞族母星的位置！
texts.en:
The crystal tells us how a rogue Zroni researcher - working on a theory which his peers refused to believe - turned his power inwards, consuming his own body in a contained Psionic chain-reaction. Following his last instructions, the dusty residue of his supreme sacrifice was tested and confirmed to be an incredibly potent source of Psionic energy. It was essentially the sum total Psionic potential of his life, rendered instantly usable by another Psion.

The crystal finally pointed us towards the location of the Zroni homeworld!

texts.zh: 泽珞星可以说是一个灵能活动的漩涡。在我们尝试派遣一个离队小组到地表之前，我们需要对过去用来探测记忆水晶的工具进行重新校准。
texts.en: Zron is a maelstrom of psionic activity. The tools we have used to detect Memory Crystals in the past will need to be recalibrated before we can even attempt sending an away team to the surface.

sections.zh: 泽珞星可以说是一个灵能活动的漩涡。在我们尝试派遣一个离队小组到地表之前，我们需要对过去用来探测记忆水晶的工具进行重新校准。
sections.en: Zron is a maelstrom of psionic activity. The tools we have used to detect Memory Crystals in the past will need to be recalibrated before we can even attempt sending an away team to the surface.

notes.zh: 泽珞（Zron）由母星系初始化器在系统生成时创建，不需要前一处遗址的标志；五个阶段，最后获得遗珍“灵能档案”。
notes.en: Zron is created by the home-system initializer when the system spawns and needs no chain flag; five stages, ending with the Psionic Archive relic.

texts.zh:
泽珞星已经被灵能风暴彻底摧毁，看上去只在某些时间才能和宇宙其他空间处于同一位面。无论发生过多么可怕的灾难，泽珞族应该自我们脚下的星球起源。

就像先前发现的殖民地一样，泽珞星依旧空无一人。但是周围的空间中充斥着水晶信号，由于存在如此多的干扰信号，这里的大气又非常诡异，搜寻有用信息可能要花费一定的时间。
texts.en:
Zron is wracked by storms of psionic energy, and appears to only be partially in phase with the rest of the universe. Whatever calamity befell the Zroni seems to have originated here.

Like all the previous colonies, it is devoid of Zroni but is teeming with crystalline signals. Given this much signal noise - on top of the strange atmospheric conditions - it may take some time for us to locate any useful information.

texts.zh:
我们发现了数个水晶并成功与其通讯，其中包括一位被流放的虚境实体研究员的记录。有了这个，我们对泽珞族的战争有了更多的了解。

以生命为代价得到的泽珞尘为福音派带来了转机，他们与升格派有了一战之力。然而，随着战败的阴影逐渐笼罩，升格派的愤怒和恐惧更进一步催化了新的可怕的虚境实体的诞生。这种反馈循环不断发展，将升格派推入疯狂的深渊。他们不断地制造更为骇人听闻的暴行，而福音派则越来越不计代价地试图终结这场战争。
texts.en:
We have found- and communicated with several crystals, including one from the outcast Shroud-entity researchers. With these, we are learning more about the Zroni's war.

Using the Zro dust required great sacrifice from the Saviors, but with it they were able to turn the tide of their war against the Divine. As their defeat loomed, the ever-increasing rage and fear of the Divine spawned new and terrible entities within the Shroud. The feedback loop grew, pushing the Divine into the depths of madness. They were driven to ever-worsening atrocities, urging the Saviors to end the war at any cost.

texts.zh:
随着我们与更多水晶建立通讯，越来越多的细节浮出水面：升格派在即将败亡之际决定实施最终计划：轮回之终末。星系核心处黑洞的增长将被加速，以尽可能快的速度吞噬掉整个星系。

在最坏的情况下，福音派（和所有其他物种）都将被毁灭，留下升格派在一段漫长却有限的时间内统治虚境，但也有可能黑洞的膨胀会达到自我维续的程度，不仅吞噬掉本星系，还会毁灭宇宙本身，给升格派提供无穷无尽的能量——就算不是无穷尽，因为能量总量和无穷足够接近，因此没有任何实际差别。
texts.en:
As we communicate with more crystals, more details emerge. On the brink of defeat, the Divine decided upon their ultimate plan: the end of the cycle. The growth of the black hole galactic core would be accelerated to consume the galaxy as soon as possible.

At worst, the Saviors - and every other species in the galaxy - would be destroyed, leaving the Divine to rule the shroud for a vast but finite time. It was, however, possible that the expansion would become self-sustaining, consuming not just the galaxy but the universe itself: providing a source of energy which may not be infinite, but would at least come close enough amount to make no practical difference.

texts.zh:
我们已经知悉了泽珞族的末路：当福音派知晓了升格派的最终计划后，加之升格派在虚境的防御简直固若金汤，他们只剩一条路可走了。毁灭已然近在眼前，他们选择牺牲几乎所有人口，只留下最后一人，最后的福音派将使用整个物种献祭而来的灵能尘去消灭每一个泽珞人——不放过升格派的任何一人——从而彻底终结这场浩劫。

泽珞族被几乎不留痕迹地从宇宙抹去，只剩下一小点未使用的泽珞尘……
texts.en:
We have learned the fate of the Zroni: when the Saviors learned of the Divine's plan, they knew there was only one possible counter to the Divine's almost-impenetrable defenses in the Shroud. Faced with annihilation, they chose to sacrifice their entire population save for one Zroni. This last remaining Savior used the psionic residue of an entire species to destroy every Zroni - and thus every Divine - in existence, ending the threat for all time.

The Zroni were wiped out almost without a trace, save for a small amount of unconsumed dust.

texts.zh: 当我们的探险队准备离开时，其中一块灵能晶体突然与我们重新建立了联系。它表示自己将会对我们有用，应该带着它一起走。即使它所言为虚，其它晶体也没有表现出任何智慧。因此我们应当带走它进行进一步的调查。
texts.en: As our expedition made ready to leave, one of the psionic crystals suddenly re-established contact. It has indicated that it could prove useful to us, should we decide to bring it with us. Even if the claim is untrue, none of the other crystals we encountered showed signs of sapience; this could warrant further investigation.

label.zh: 获得遗珍后：激活灵能档案（可重复）
label.en: With the relic: activate the Psionic Archive (repeatable)

note.zh: 18 已设置 zroni_completed；19 给予遗珍与大量文物。
note.en: 18 already set zroni_completed; 19 grants the relic and a large artifact reward.

texts.zh:
当我们触摸灵魂石时，我们被投影到了虚境的一处微缩位面中。我们很快意识到自己并非这片令人目眩的奇妙秘境中唯一的存在。这里有一个存在等待着我们，其古老的程度远超我们可以计量的范围。那是一位上古秘辛的守护者。贾巴克斯提，我们本能地知道这一点。

在通过了与其建立联系的试炼后，这个存在等待着我们发问。
texts.en:
As we touch the Soulstone, we are projected in to a microcosm of the Shroud. We become aware that we are not alone in this swirling twilight realm. There is an entity awaiting us, one immeasurably ancient. A keeper of secrets. Ja'Baxti, we instinctively know.

Having passed the test of making contact with it, the entity awaits our questions.

texts.zh:
灵魂石内部光芒闪耀，仿佛在无言地召唤着我们。我们触摸了灵魂石，而后我们的心灵被吸入了虚境中一处微缩的位面，在这里一个被称作贾巴克斯提的存在等待着我们。

它知道凡人无法得知的事情，由于我们已经来到了它的圣所，它似乎愿意将它的秘密同我们分享。
texts.en:
The Soulstone, pulsing with inner light, seems to wordlessly beckon. We touch it, and our minds are drawn in to a pocket dimension of the Shroud, where the enigmatic entity called Ja'Baxti awaits.

It knows things no mortal being could know, and seems willing to share its secrets now that we have reached its sanctum.

label.zh: 要求贾巴克斯提分享一个洞见
label.en: Ask Ja'Baxti to share an insight

label.zh: 向贾巴克斯提寻求军事建议
向贾巴克斯提寻求治国之方
label.en: Ask Ja'Baxti about matters of state

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的统治者的名字。
note.en: In the game, your ruler's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的统治者的称谓。
note.en: In the game, your ruler's title appears here.

notes.zh: 每次激活三选一：统治者提升1级（技能未满10）、1800天军事修正或1800天治国修正；两段正文随机其一。
notes.en: Each activation offers one of three requests: the ruler gains a level (below skill 10), a 1800-day martial modifier, or a 1800-day state modifier; one of two texts is shown.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Zroni

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求泽珞族的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Zroni to our own.

texts.zh: 我们已成功将泽珞族文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对灵能研究的洞见将极大地帮助我们。
texts.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Zroni artifacts into our research process. Their insights into psionic study will greatly aid our own research.

note.zh: 灵能理论研究选项与进度（或社会学研究），并获得灵能研究修正。
note.en: Psionic Theory option and progress (or society research), plus a psionics research modifier.

summary.text:
# 泽珞族 / The Zroni

- 分类 Category：先驱者 Precursors · 来源 Sources：events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:14–580、6917；common/archaeological_site_types/01_precursor_arc_sites.txt:4–261；common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:7758；common/solar_system_initializers/ancient_relics_initializers.txt:179；common/artifact_actions/artifact_actions.txt:812；common/relics/relics.txt:1024 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

非AI帝国勘察泽珞星域（precursor_zroni_1 星系）中一颗无异常、无遗址、未殖民的宜居星球时，on_survey_planet 以权重35可能抽中开场 ancrel.1“神秘废墟”。全银河只触发一次（全局 zroni_started），且该帝国不能已有其他先驱者开场。回应在该星球建立“废弃殖民地遗迹”。

A non-AI empire surveying an anomaly-free, site-free, uncolonised habitable world in a Zroni region system can draw the opening ancrel.1 "Mysterious Ruins" (weight 35) from on_survey_planet. It fires once per galaxy (global zroni_started) and needs no other precursor opening. The response creates the Abandoned Colony Ruins site.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

六处遗址严格依次出现；每处最后阶段在3–15跳内放置下一处：
1. 废弃殖民地遗迹（3阶段）：空城→会“想被找到”的水晶→灵能档案：泽珞族在集体梦境中接触“虚境”并能投射其中。
2. 泽珞信标（2阶段）：借虚境跳跃散布银河。
3. 泽珞神殿（2阶段）：神力的能量来自银河中心黑洞的膨胀；“神圣者”与“拯救者”两派内战。
4. 泽珞研究站（2阶段）：被嘲笑的研究者发现虚境中由集体恐惧与欲望凝成的实体。
5. 泽珞核心世界（3阶段）：战争进程；一名研究者以自身化为“泽珞尘”，水晶最终指向母星。
6. 若为首个完成者，隐藏的 ancrel.14 生成母星系（无位置则30天后重试），其中的“泽珞”遗址（5阶段）揭示：拯救者用泽珞尘扭转战局，神圣者陷入疯狂并计划加速黑洞吞噬银河；拯救者牺牲全族只留一人，用全族的灵能残余消灭了所有泽珞族。最后一个有感知的水晶请求被带走（遗珍“灵能档案”）。
7. 可选：ancrel.14 设置 last_zroni_system，可另行花750稀有文物开启“探究泽珞族的秘密”（社会学）→ 10350；遗珍可反复激活 → 7006“灵能指引”。

Six sites appear strictly in order; each last stage places the next one 3–15 jumps away:
1. Abandoned Colony Ruins (3 stages): an empty city → a crystal that "wanted to be found" → a Psionic Archive: the Zroni reached the Shroud through mass dreaming and learned to project into it.
2. Zroni Beacon (2): psionic jumps spread them across the galaxy.
3. Zroni Shrine (2): their godhood fed on the growth of the galactic core's black hole; civil war between the Divine and the Saviors.
4. Zroni Research Station (2): a ridiculed researcher found entities formed in the Shroud from collective fears and desires.
5. Zroni Core World (3): the course of the war; a researcher turned himself into Zro dust; the crystal points to the homeworld.
6. If first to finish, hidden ancrel.14 spawns the home system (retry after 30 days); its Zron site (5 stages) reveals that the Saviors turned the war with Zro dust, the Divine planned to accelerate the black hole, and the Saviors sacrificed all but one of their kind, whose blast of psionic residue destroyed every Zroni. A last sapient crystal asks to be taken (relic: Psionic Archive).
7. Optional: ancrel.14 sets last_zroni_system → "Secrets of the Zroni" for 750 minor artifacts (society) → 10350; the relic can be activated repeatedly → 7006 "Psionic Guidance".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 主线没有分支；每处遗址的掷骰失败可能引发通用发掘意外（见故事“考古遗址：发掘意外”）。
- 终章 19 给予遗珍；18 设置 zroni_completed。
- 7006：每次激活三选一——统治者提升1级（技能未满10）、1800天军事修正、1800天治国修正。

- No branches in the main line; failed rolls at any site can trigger generic excavation incidents (see "Archaeological Sites: excavation incidents").
- Finale 19 grants the relic; 18 sets zroni_completed.
- 7006: each activation offers one of three — the ruler gains a level (below skill 10), a 1800-day martial or a 1800-day state modifier.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 4 若尚未拥有灵能理论则开放其研究与进度，否则给社会学研究；10350 同理。
- 第2处遗址的两个阶段事件在游戏中的标题沿用本地化键 zroni_digsite_5/6（“泽珞核心世界”“泽珞”），属原文现象。

- Stage 4 grants Psionic Theory as an option with progress if unknown, else society research; 10350 likewise.
- Site 2's two stage events use the keys zroni_digsite_5/6 as titles ("Zroni Core World", "Zron") — an original-text quirk.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：ancrel.1–19、六处遗址的阶段定义、zroni_digsite_spawn_effect、Zrocursor_system 初始化器、artifact_zroni_research、ZRONI_SECRETS 与 10350、r_zro_crystal 与 7006；中英文正文已读。
- 结构修正：前往泽珞与秘密研究的桥改为挂在 ancrel.13 的回应上并附证据；原为独立单页故事的遗珍激活 7006 并入本故事；补充阶段标签与说明。

- Checked: ancrel.1–19, stage definitions of the six sites, the spawn effect, the Zrocursor_system initializer, artifact_zroni_research, ZRONI_SECRETS and 10350, r_zro_crystal and 7006; both languages read.
- Structural fixes: the bridges to Zron and to the secrets research now hang on ancrel.13's response with evidence; relic activation 7006 (previously a separate one-card story) joined as an optional follow-up; stage labels and notes added.
